Items quantised value, Likert scales dropdowns, get second column ending _quantised: gorilla_participants() lists participant’s status, device, start end time, randomiser branch outcomes last value store field: summary() describes task questionnaire one row, gorilla_checks() lists participants may need closer look: incomplete participants, people took part twice, missing tasks, fast identical responses, unusual devices randomiser groups unequal size. read data, give read_gorilla() folder ZIP file downloaded Data tab: Recordings Eye Tracking (Webgazer) Mouse Tracking components Task Builder 2 saved separate files, one per trial. read_eyetracking() read_mousetracking() read , assign sample zone screen falls , take task screen names main export: public IDs come recruitment platform Prolific, blind_ids() replaces codes share data. write_gorilla() saves tidy tables CSV files, analysis software:
